SYNTHETIC TRAINING EVIDENCE | AL-X26 | Not an official instrument   Page 1  Purchase agreement and amendment  Executed agreement extract | September 18, 2026  File AL-X26. Property: 18 Alder Lane, Kingston, Ontario. Parcel identifier DEMO-PIN-001. Purchaser Alex Chen. Vendor Morgan Ellis. Price CAD 700,000. Deposit CAD 35,000 held by fictional transaction counsel. Completion October 15, 2026. Residential freehold purchase. Schedule A describes the main lot as Lot 12, fictional Plan DEMO-44. Marketing particulars also describe a rear access strip, Part 2, DEMO-PLAN-82. The signed legal-description schedule includes Lot 12 only; Part 2 is not expressly included. Purchaser expects exclusive vehicle access to the rear garage. Vendor promises vacant possession, subject to any tenancy expressly accepted in a signed amendment. Vendor states that notices received concerning the premises will be delivered to counsel. Buyer acknowledges that an old survey is supplied for information only. Jordan Vale signs correspondence as representative. The agreement records that documents establishing authority to execute the transfer and direct proceeds must be supplied separately. This extract does not certify execution, identity or authority.

No one may treat the draft as an executed extension.

pages: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY | Not an official instrument or FCT guidance   Pack page 1 / 12  FICTIONAL CORRECTED BRANCH EVIDENCE  Signed transaction clarification  AL-AM-15 | AL-X26 | October 15, 2026 | 08:00  Parties and unchanged commercial terms  File AL-X26. Part 2, DEMO-PLAN-82, being DEMO-PIN-002, remains owned by Rowan Mercer and is not conveyed. Final transfer AL-T15 conveys DEMO-PIN-001 only to Alex Chen for CAD 700,000; Jordan and Casey both executed it at 08:10. Remaining scope  The origin of the disputed messages is not established by this follow-up; no finding of criminal conduct or impersonation is made. The suspicious communications are retained in the file. These records document the response to the specific payment risk and do not authenticate themselves merely by being uploaded.
